scope: Bound the explicit local fixture discovery client so response bodies are streamed under the 2 MB ceiling and active local requests stop promptly when the durable worker cancellation/deadline callback raises.

validation.target: Reproduce eager oversized buffering and stalled response cancellation before production changes
validation.summary: After correcting the synthetic client injection setup, both regression tests failed: all 100 body chunks were buffered and a stalled response did not stop within 0.3 seconds.

validation.target: Fixture response bounds, public-company identity boundaries, application preflight, mock ATS controls and connected core workflow
validation.summary: 31 unit, integration and browser tests passed.

validation.target: Exact candidate full local unit/integration/browser discovery
validation.summary: 708 tests ran in 393.744 seconds, zero failures/errors, one optional PostgreSQL skip because MJOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL was unset.

observed_test_setup_issue: The first cancellation test setup created MockClient before installing its synthetic transport and therefore failed to start the fixture response. The test was corrected to inject the transport at construction; the intended cancellation regression then failed before implementation and passed after.
requirement_limitations: This slice covers the local fixture discovery client only. Public Greenhouse and public-company clients have separate scoped bounds; remaining operation classes still need evidence.
AI provider/runtime and real ATS paths remain unavailable/disabled and keep MJ-REQ-004 PARTIAL.
